purpose: Practical portable completion proposal; not exhaustive native discovery or Ada coverage certification

objectives.PORTABLE: Normal Ada value/matrix, numeric, persistence and diagnostics capabilities; primary 0.6 target with explicit supported modes
objectives.OPTIONAL: Consumer-backed version-specific, accelerator, advanced lifetime or special-purpose extensions; not automatic stabilization requirements
objectives.NATIVE_SURFACE: Template instantiations, generated operators, HAL and dispatch are preserved research evidence, not mandatory Ada entry points

candidates.reason: Every downstream module needs cheap scalar offsets/scales and threshold masks without full constant matrices; bounded Mat-only additions use native operations on all four releases
Pairwise error and descriptor distances are common across Features, Calib3D and navigation; current two-Mat Norm profile is already a mask, so use distinct names
All modules need actual linked native version/build diagnostics; two copied String results are low-cost and portable across all references
Useful for tensor consumers, but no 4.1 native entry; basic image/point pipelines do not justify a custom historical algorithm
Native only in 4.10/5.0 among references; require a tensor consumer and explicit version gate, not an unproved fallback
Ada.Real_Time already supplies ordinary timing; native tick parity is convenient but not essential to module bindings
Explicit global controls can help Ada tasking, but concurrent mutation is unsafe and backend worker counts vary; runtime diagnostics ship without setters
Strong allocation-stable pipeline value for UMat users, not a requirement that CPU Mat consumers adopt accelerator parity
UMat reshape shares storage; DFT/DCT backend limits and lifetime/alias contracts need focused native probes before selecting a public subset
5.0-only Core entry among references; packed CCS and zero-denominator semantics do not justify an unproved pre-5 numerical backport
5.0 native finiteMask useful for robustness, but Check_Range already supports reject/diagnose workflows; no assumed compare(X,X) infinity fallback
Owned N-D storage, 32 typed layouts/traversal, dense conversion, scaling, Float32/Float64 C1 norms/extrema already cover baseline use; sufficiency is a scope decision, not BOUND_FULL certification
No evidence for a general native SparseMat add/subtract family; do not invent a sparse arithmetic library or call it a confirmed missing binding
Native sparse normalize forbids shifting implicit zero; explicit To_Dense is the correct alternative
XML/YAML/JSON disk/memory, typed values/Mat and scoped map/sequence navigation already support ordinary configuration without escaping FileNode lifetimes
Useful for large/calibration records but rewrites and current typed storage suffice; separate small native-option PRs after real consumer need
Ada filename validator does not reject .gz, but public spec excludes it and native zlib is optional; neither claim unsupported execution nor promise qualified compression
Avoid borrowed node/iterator lifetime coupling; existing indexed reads/map keys retain semantic traversal; safe callbacks remain an optional proposal
Pose consumer value is plausible, not demonstrated mandatory; unit conventions/interpolation and 4.1 absence make Quat/DualQuat math a separate consumer-backed design
AsyncPromise is public despite detail/; retain it with AsyncArray as optional producer/result API, pending Ada task/finalization/exception model
5.0 BF16/Bool/unsigned32/64/signed64 are optional extensions; existing depth/channel/rank conversions must remain safe even when new types are not exposed
Excluded only from mandatory portable 0.6 target: CUDA/OpenCL/OpenGL/DirectX/VA device and allocator APIs remain present documented optional interfaces, not absent upstream
Exact C++ template specialization/operator/HAL/dispatch/STL and legacy C syntactic parity is not Ada capability completeness; public value semantics and depth macros are retained separately
Credit Matrix_Multiply/Add, Transposed_Product, K_Nearest_Neighbors, Min_Max_Indices, Singular_Value_Decomposition and Covariance; no blanket native overload completeness claim

tasks.scope: Bounded Mat/scalar add/subtract/multiply/divide and C1 scalar comparisons, return and caller-owned destination forms; native operations only
tasks.api: Reuse OpenCV.Scalar for arithmetic C1..C4; Double-valued scalar Compare for C1; explicit reverse subtract/divide names or unambiguous overloads; no public C types
tasks.exclusions: Initial subset: 2-D, seven non-Float16 public depths, unmasked, source-depth output, no mixed Mat/UMat or scalar-expression framework; C>4 and Float16 explicitly rejected
tasks.tests: C1/C3/C4, all seven depths, signed extrema/rounding/zero division, reverse operands, scalar compare outside integer range and fractions, typed/default empty policy, ROI/alias/rebind, invalid ABI, NaN/Inf and validation profile
tasks.complexity: Medium; one feature PR with arithmetic then comparison commits; split only if vertical review becomes too large

tasks.scope: Direct-native unary/pairwise numerical L1/L2/Infinity/squared-L2, pairwise relative numerical modes, unmasked Hamming/Hamming2; numeric selector masks
tasks.api: Difference_Norm distinct from existing Norm(Self,Mask); Squared_L2_Norm and Hamming_Norm/Hamming_Distance strong cell kind avoid new ambiguous two-Mat overload; Relative option only on numeric difference
tasks.exclusions: Initial UInt8/Int8/UInt16/Int16/Float32/Float64 only; reject Int32 and Float16 for new functions because legacy difference paths subtract before widening; existing Norm unchanged; numeric channels folded as native; UInt8 C1 binary distance only, no Hamming mask/relative mode, no UMat; native sizes bounded against signed-int accumulation
tasks.tests: Direct native parity, squared relation, safe 8/16-bit opposite extrema without saturated Abs_Diff, Int32 rejection and explicit Float64 conversion alternative, N-D strided masks, zero reference epsilon behavior, binary bit/2-bit cells, type/shape rejection, large-count preflight guards, NaN/Inf, ABI outputs
tasks.complexity: Medium; independent of scalar task, retain existing Norm_Kind for source compatibility

tasks.scope: Native_Version_String and Native_Build_Information copied runtime queries only
tasks.api: String-returning operations in existing OpenCV.Core, no new public package or ownership type; existing OpenCV_Error translation
tasks.exclusions: No native global setters, timers, error callback framework, cached compile-time version substitute or parsed build schema
tasks.tests: Version equals linked native reference, nonempty build text, independent strings after subsequent calls, caller buffer null/capacity and output initialization, installed/relocated consumer, no exact build-text snapshot
tasks.complexity: Small; independent and safe to start immediately

tasks.scope: Consumer-selected N-D transpose/flip/broadcast or 5.0 finiteMask as separate PRs
tasks.api: Strong permutation/axis/shape or finite mask operation
tasks.tests: Native supported-version matrix, strides/count overflow, unsupported-version failure, empty/alias and nonfinite cases
tasks.complexity: Medium per separate feature; requires consumer and focused safety review

tasks.scope: Consumer-selected native timing or optimization/thread controls as separate PRs
tasks.api: Exact-width ticks and explicit process-global controls, not instance properties
tasks.exclusions: No concurrent setter safety or exact worker-count guarantee
tasks.tests: State restore on exceptions, outside parallel region, frequency positive, no timing thresholds or bitwise numeric guarantees

tasks.scope: UMat unmasked/masked Copy_To destination and masked Set_To; no reshape in same PR
tasks.api: Mirror existing Mat destination procedures with UMat masks
tasks.exclusions: No host staging, mixed operands, direct mapping or GPU-execution promise
tasks.tests: Fresh-mask zeroing versus reused preservation, ROI/disjoint/partial alias rules, rebind and retained parent, OpenCL disabled, ABI failures

tasks.scope: FileStorage disk append then Base64 as separately reviewable PRs
tasks.api: Strong options/modes retaining limited storage owner
tasks.exclusions: No gzip contract until qualified, no native MEMORY+APPEND, no escaping FileNode
tasks.tests: Existing/new file, duplicate keys documented, malformed input, close errors, XML/YAML/JSON and Mat round trips
tasks.complexity: Small-medium per option; no dependence on native census closure
